traits.note: Plants of the World Online's account of the rose family, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): flowers regular, sepals 5 and petals usually 5, free, the calyx joined at its base in a hypanthium that bears the sepals, petals and stamens; carpels indefinite in Rosa. B. Ertter's Native California Roses (University and Jepson Herbaria) on Rosa nutkana: hypanthium 5 to 7 mm wide in flower; GOERT's species page: ovaries superior but enclosed in the urn-shaped floral tube.
